title: 第9章 大闹天宫第10章 新跟班
slug: 丹尊至上第391章驿站交接
content_zh:
随着三长老林震的声音落下。
庭院之内，所有人的目光，都下意识地，投向了院角那片，最深沉的阴影之中。
那里，空无一物。
然而，那片阴影，扭曲了一下。
一道，身着朴素灰袍、身形挺拔的身影，便如同，从另一个空间，渗透出来一般，悄无声息地，出现在了众人眼前。
他看起来，约莫二十岁上下，面容，普通至极，是那种，扔进人堆里，就再也找不出来的类型。
但，他的一双眼睛，却亮得，有些吓人。
那是一种，仿佛鹰隼般，锐利、冷静、且，不带丝毫感情的眼神。
他的背后，用粗糙的灰布，包裹着一柄，比他整个人，还要宽上几分的……巨剑。
整个人，就如同一柄，藏于鞘中的绝世凶兵，沉默，却又，充满了，致命的危险！
“天儿，”
三长老，为林天介绍道。
“这位，便是韩立。
乃是老夫一位故人之子，自幼，便独自一人，在山野中苦修，是一位，心性与实力，都极为可靠的剑客。”
“韩立小友，”
他又对着那灰衣青年，笑道，“这位，便是我跟你提过的，林天。”
林天，看着韩立。
韩立，也在看着林天。
四目相对，空气，仿佛都在这一刻，凝固了。
林天，能从对方那看似平凡的身躯之中，感受到一股，凝练到了极致的、仿佛随时都能，撕裂一切的……锋锐剑意！

他知道，此人，手上，沾过血。
而且，不止一条人命。
而韩立，则能从林天那看似只有炼气巅峰的修为之下，感受到一片，浩瀚如宇宙星海般的……恐怖神魂！
他那剑客的直觉，在疯狂地，向他预警！
眼前这个少年，比他见过的任何一头妖兽，都要……危险！
“我需要，一把刀。”
林天，率先开口，声音平淡，却直指核心。
“一把，能为我斩断所有的快刀。”
“我能得到什么？”
韩立的声音，沙哑，而又简洁。
“你想要什么？”
林天，反问道。
“资源。”
韩立，毫不犹豫地说道，“能让我变得更强的资源。
丹药，法器，功法……以及，”
他顿了顿，那双古井无波的眼眸中，第一次，闪过了一丝，名为“渴望”
的火焰，“一个，能让我，看到‘剑道’更高处风景的机会。”
林天，笑了。
他手腕一翻，一个，小小的玉瓶，便如同流星般，飞向了韩立。
“这里面，是十枚，我‘炖’的极品‘凝气丹’。

算是定金。”
content_en:
As the third elder Lin Zhen's voice fell.
In the courtyard, everyone's eyes subconsciously turned to the deepest shadow in the corner of the courtyard.
There was nothing there.
However, the shadow was distorted.
A tall figure wearing a simple gray robe appeared in front of everyone quietly, as if seeping out from another space.
He looked to be about twenty years old, and his face was extremely ordinary. He was the kind of person who would never be found again if thrown into a crowd.
However, his eyes were so bright that it was a little scary.
It was a look that was as sharp, calm, and emotionless as an eagle.
Behind his back, wrapped in rough gray cloth, was a huge sword that was a bit wider than his entire body.
The whole person is like a peerless weapon hidden in a sheath, silent, yet full of fatal danger!
"Tian'er,"
The third elder introduced Lin Tian.
"This is Han Li.
He is the son of an old friend of mine. He has been practicing hard in the mountains and fields alone since he was a child. He is an extremely reliable swordsman with both temperament and strength. "
"Little friend Han Li,"
He then smiled at the young man in gray and said, "This is the one I mentioned to you, Lin Tian."
Lin Tian looked at Han Li.
Han Li was also looking at Lin Tian.
Their eyes met, and the air seemed to freeze at this moment.
Lin Tian could sense from the opponent's seemingly ordinary body a sharp sword intent that was condensed to the extreme and seemed to be able to tear everything apart at any time!
He knew that this man had blood on his hands.
And, more than one life.
Han Li, on the other hand, could feel a terrifying soul as vast as the sea of ​​stars in the universe from Lin Tian's cultivation, which seemed to be at the peak of Qi refining!
His swordsman's intuition was frantically warning him!
The young man in front of him was more... dangerous than any monster he had ever seen!
"I need a knife."
Lin Tian spoke first, his voice was calm but pointed to the core.
"A sharp knife that can cut off everything for me."
"What do I get?"
Han Li's voice was hoarse and concise.
"What do you want?"
Lin Tian asked rhetorically.
"Resources."
Han Li said without hesitation, "Resources that can make me stronger.
Pills, magic weapons, exercises...and,"
He paused, and for the first time, a glimmer of "desire" flashed through his ancient eyes.
The flame, "an opportunity that allows me to see the higher scenery of the 'Sword Way'."
Lin Tian smiled.
He flipped his wrist, and a small jade bottle flew towards Han Li like a shooting star.
"Inside, there are ten of the top quality 'Qi Condensing Pills' that I 'stewed'.
It's a deposit. "
